title: Act: Add EffectRenderContext and buildEffects
description: Add effect context types and buildEffects.
acceptance_criteria: buildEffects returns handles for dust and ambient light only
buildEffects plays the fade transition through the context

steps.action: Append interface EffectHandle { destroy(): void } and interface EffectRenderContext { createEffect(spec: EffectSpec & { depth: number }): EffectHandle; playTransition(durationMs: number): void } with `import type { EffectSpec } from '../content/schema'` at top

Export buildEffects(ctx: EffectRenderContext, scene: SceneSpec): EffectHandle[]; for each effect of scene.effects ?? []: if type is 'transition' call ctx.playTransition(e.durationMs) else push ctx.createEffect({ ...e, depth: layerDepth('effects') }); return the handles
steps.expected: Returns handles for dust and light only
